mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.userId, c.dishId, c.quantity, d.dishName, d.coverImage, d.price, d.price * c.quantity AS subtotal FROM cartItem c JOIN dish d ON d.id = c.dishId WHERE c.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cartItem (userId, dishId, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}
